sourceName: UNDP Human Development Report 2025 – composite indices and components time series
version: HDR 2025 data update, complete time series 1990–2023

auxiliarySources.purpose: Map UNDP ISO alpha-3 codes to the Natural Earth numeric ids used by the globe.

attribution: Source: United Nations Development Programme, Human Development Report 2025; transformed by Mundus. Licensed under CC BY 3.0 IGO.
transformations: Keep country and territory rows with three-character UNDP ISO codes and preserve missing cells as null
Keep reported HDI values and derive health, education and income dimension indices using HDR 2025 Technical Note 1 goalposts
Education index: arithmetic mean of clamped expected-years / 18 and mean-years / 15 indices
Income index: clamp((ln(GNI per capita) - ln(100)) / (ln(75000) - ln(100)), 0, 1)
Join to Natural Earth through ISO alpha-3 and numeric codes; retain unmapped small states for the semantic table
Encode 1990–2023 values as compact arrays ordered by year
missingValuePolicy: Blank, non-numeric or incomplete component values remain null and are never converted to zero. A derived dimension is null if any required component is missing.
boundaryPolicy: Country coloring uses Natural Earth 110m cartographic units. UNDP rows without a corresponding 110m polygon remain available in the table but are not painted on the globe.
